column4: You are always impeccably clean and can choose exactly how you’d like to smell, no matter what you’ve been through. From your perspective, everything and everyone around you also smells perfectly pleasant—even if you’re wading through filth or haven’t seen a bath in weeks.

You hold full control over your own fertility, deciding precisely if and when you wish to conceive, without fear of accidental pregnancy. Additionally, you are entirely immune to diseases transmitted through intimacy, granting you peace of mind and security in even the closest liaisons. If you experience them, you may choose to never have a period again should you wish it to be so.

You possess an incredible gift for shaping and guiding the social structures around you. Be it restructuring a city’s governance, shaping cultural practices, or controlling the flow of information within a council or court, your talent can have consequences that reach far further than the group you began in. With careful planning, you can manipulate public opinion, create and split factions, and even mold traditions to benefit yourself.

Those above you in the political hierarchy, particularly the king, always heed your counsel, even in the face of vehement disagreement. They process your advice with a clarity that pierces through ego, stubbornness, or impulsive tendencies, rather than letting pride or emotion cloud their judgment. This sway allows you to temper extreme decisions and act as a steady hand that pulls the realm back from the brink.

You have access to a vast wardrobe in whatever style you desire, from Westerosi finery to the exotic garb of distant lands. Regardless of appearance, these clothes adapt to make you comfortable in any weather, remaining perpetually clean unless you prefer to blend in with a bit of grime.

Why settle for gruel and moldy bread when you can dine like a king? This item ensures you receive three exquisite meals a day, perfectly suited to your tastes. From succulent roasts to delicate pastries, every dish is a culinary masterpiece. Even better, no one will find it odd if your meals differ from theirs, ensuring you avoid awkward questions while savoring your private feast. Never go hungry, and never compromise on flavor.

You have an assistant which excels at absolutely everything you assign them with a level of focus and proficiency that puts others to shame. Be it managing logistics, devising strategies, overseeing finances, or organizing complex political maneuvers, they are masters at what they do. They are versatile, adaptable, and proactive, and utterly competent and capable of turning even your most ambitious plans into reality.

When someone is considering who to appoint for a position you desire, you will be the first name that comes to mind. Whilst this won’t stop them from choosing someone grossly more qualified and experienced, it will give you an edge if it’s a choice between you, and someone of a similar or slightly greater competence.

Within your veins pumps the blood of one of the Great Houses of Westeros, such as Stark or Lannister. As befitting of your blood, people give you more attention than they normally would when you demand it and are far more likely to bend to your demands or orders than normal. This also gives you a bit of divine right to rule causing vassals to be far less likely to betray you, after all your family has ruled well for centuries.

A title of land equal to what someone of your station would expect. Regular warriors may have a small block for them and their family, a lord may have a castle, and the surrounding area, a lord paramount may have a massive castle, and an enormous area around as their personal domain, and a royal may have not just an enormous castle, but also an area near equal to the other kingdoms as their land.
They may call it arrogance but when you stay out of conflicts neither side can pull you in without your consent. This allows you to conserve your power while they duke it out.

You have an almost supernatural knack for saying just the right thing at the right time to be selected for prestigious or influential tasks. Be it a quiet word in a lord’s ear, a rousing speech, or an earnest request, your words naturally present you as the ideal candidate for opportunities that lead to power, wealth, or influence. You are frequently offered chances others might dream of, as your instincts for advancement are sharp and reliable.

Those who directly work for you are bound by a loyalty that defies all attempts at betrayal. Their dedication to you is unbreakable, immune to bribery, coercion, or even ideological persuasion. This allegiance is more than mere respect; it’s a deeply ingrained trust that keeps them from ever wavering or plotting against you. While this unwavering allegiance does not extend infinitely outward to every person in your network, it ensures your immediate agents and allies remain steadfast in your service.

You understand reputation like no other, able to enhance your standing or protect yourself from rumors with remarkable skill. When speaking about yourself or others, you can subtly manipulate public opinion to your advantage, making small incidents seem grand or turning scandals into mere misunderstandings. Whether seeking to bolster your influence or protect an ally’s name, your social influence allows you to sway reputations as easily as turning a page.

This dark, beautifully crafted quill binds any contract signed with it to the full force of fate itself. Once someone signs their name, they are bound to their oath without question, though they remain unquestioning of the quill’s true nature. Anyone who uses the quill will be aware of the consequences of signing with it. Neither oaths nor terms can be violated by the signer without dire consequence.

Living in King’s Landing can be exhausting, especially if you’re confined to the Red Keep. This item grants you ownership of a luxurious estate in the city, complete with fine furnishings, loyal servants, and the privacy to escape the madness of court. Alternatively, you can choose to fully customize your quarters within the Red Keep, outfitting them to your specifications. Want plumbing? Secret compartments? A cozy library? It’s yours. This item will function wherever you are living, no matter how temporary.

Ser Criston Cole was prepared to end his life before Alicent gave him purpose. Afterwards, he became her most fervent supporter. Larys Strong was on the sidelines, overlooked and unutilized before Alicent struck up an unusual quid pro quo for his services as a spymaster. You have a similar ability to find potential allies among the broken, discarded, and ignored members of society. They may not be nice people, but the most loyal dogs are the ones you rescue from the street.

It is easy for you to ferret out secrets and lies from people at a disadvantage to you. You could listen to a conversation by lurking in the background almost out of sight and those in pain will be hard-pressed to lie to you.

You have an innate understanding of hidden passages, secret exits, and concealed spaces, particularly within King’s Landing but extending to most other significant locations. Whether finding long-forgotten passages throughout the Red Keep or knowing exactly which false wall opens into a forgotten storeroom, you have perfect instincts for discovering and utilizing them. Every city and castle you pass through seems eager to reveal its secrets to you.

It wouldn’t be much of a game without a throne to win. Now you have a throne of a style which matches your aesthetic and theme. If you’re a conqueror king, then perhaps you have an iron throne, whereas if you’re a humble king, you might have a simple wooden bench. Your throne emits an aura which conveys the kind of king you are. If you are a harsh, cruel king, then your throne might feel cold and stark like the seastone throne, whilst if you are a knightly king, then your throne might create a sense of chivalry and honour. Whilst you sit on your throne, any subjects you may have will be far more subservient, your lands will be more efficient, and none will doubt your kingship.

This object when worn grants the wearer the authority of the highest leader of their local area (or if they’re actually representing someone, them). By default, it takes the form of a golden pin held by a hand, but after this jump it can take whatever design you wish.

In the treacherous world of Westerosi politics, your sharp tongue is both feared and respected. When you express a truth, be it blunt, through a veiled insult, or a rebuke, people will listen and recognize the validity in what you say. People may not like it, but they recognize your correctness when you’re truthful, even if the way you say it stings.

You have an unparalleled knack for revealing truths. Through subtle observations and skillfully crafted questions, you can draw out secrets and detect lies without raising a hint of suspicion. Even the most guarded individuals find themselves unwittingly revealing hidden details in your presence. You can easily cut through layers of deception, discerning the true meaning behind people's words and intentions.

Your mind for systems and bureaucracy stands above all others in history. You see systems, be they legal, social, or bureaucratic, more clearly than anyone else, understanding their inner workings, identifying vulnerabilities, and knowing how to exploit or improve them. When you look at a structure, you easily assess its efficiencies and efficacies, and how to best apply them to your benefit.

Finding talent in a realm as large as Westeros is no easy feat—yet you have an unparalleled gift for locating the best and convincing them to join your cause. Whether they are renowned warriors, brilliant scholars, or masterful spies, people of great skill are naturally drawn to you. Convincing them to leave their prior loyalties behind is rarely a challenge, and those you recruit feel a deep sense of purpose and trust in your leadership.

In your possession is a source of immense wealth—perhaps a series of rich mines rivaling the famed Lannister gold or vast vineyards and wineries on the scale of the Redwynes. Whatever form it takes, this enterprise is a vast operation, run by a skilled workforce and knowledgeable experts who ensure smooth, profitable production. The income is staggering, enough to raise even a destitute family to prominence, and, with this alone, you could rival the wealthiest houses in Westeros.

A single bottle of the finest Arbor Gold, a vintage so rare and smooth that it’s guaranteed to impress even the most skeptical of drinkers. But its true power lies in its ability to grease the wheels of deception. Serve this wine to someone, and they will believe almost any lie you tell them during the course of their intoxication. However, the effects are not foolproof—evidence to the contrary will break the illusion, and once sobriety returns, the lie will be judged as any other. Use it to spin tales, seal deals, or save your life in a pinch.

You have a full Westerosi castle. This is a fortification comparable to Winterfell itself, being capable of holding several thousand people, enchanted with to be immune to offensive magics, and to keep out a single sentient species which is defined at the start of each jump.

You are viewed as too important to be challenged or taken down. This could be due to your status, influence, or strategic importance, those around you dare not risk slighting, ignoring, or harming you. This “diplomatic immunity” is not bound to a specific title, but rather to the perception that your removal or insult would be too costly or damaging for those in power to consider.

This perk grants you a reliable and influential support network tailored to your role and needs. These individuals—whether advisors, warriors, administrators, or informants—are among the best in their fields and are completely loyal to you. The individuals within your network are invaluable assets who understand your goals and work tirelessly to see them fulfilled.  Should any member of your network perish in the line of duty, they will reappear within a week after all conflicts or dangerous situations have concluded, restored exactly as they were. However, be advised that “conflict” extends beyond open warfare to intense political or strategic confrontations where their expertise is critical.
